requiredFindings.title: A non-ending chain of exactly 64 nodes is the incomplete row when G+1 equals 64
requiredFindings.failureScenario: Pair generation 63 makes lineage_bound return (64, false), because the session limit is marked only when G+1 is greater than 64. A chain whose 64th node still has a predecessor stops inspect_supplied at Limit. The gate returns Incomplete(Chain). The observation session records a Chain finding. A non-doctor writer or reader then ends on CONFIG.CUSTODY_REFUSED subject installation-incomplete, exit 2. Doctor lists a chain defect and the chain remedy. Law X3a item 3 requires the budget row for a chain longer than 64: operational-failed, exit 4, SYSTEM.OUTCOME.ILLEGAL_STATE, WORK.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, host-invariant. The budget tests select generation 64 (65 nodes) and take the greater-than branch. The 64-node tests select generation 63 on a chain that ends at a root, so they never hit Limit. Required: when the walk stops because 64 nodes were read and the chain has not ended, the row is the budget row even when G+1 equals 64. Chain remains the row only when the walk stops at a generation bound strictly below 64.

scope: X3a-1 implements law X3a r5 items 1, 2, 5, 6 and 7, and item 3 except the 64-node equality. RF-1: generation 63 with a non-ending 64-node chain is Incomplete(Chain) rather than the budget row. Inventory v83 adds two files on v82 and is ACCEPT. Replay: host lib 4 passed; security lib 22 passed, 19 of them this unit. Workspace suite, clippy, fmt and check_package_edges not replayed.
